title: EvidenceArtifact
description: One immutable invocation record (punokawan-14yn.7): a test, diff, API check, command, screenshot, or review produced exactly this content-addressed blob. Bytes are addressed by sha256 (never overwritten, never trusted from a caller - always server-computed); this record's own id is a ULID and is what gets referenced elsewhere, never a mutable path. See affiliate-platform-delivery-feedback-2026-08-07.md.

producer.description: What invoked this (e.g. "go test", "petruk-plan"), for provenance.

retain_until.description: Retention horizon; absent means retained indefinitely.
